goal_contributions_sign_check.name: goal_contributions_sign_check
goal_contributions_sign_check.value:
CASE WHEN "goal_contributions"."kind"::text = 'withdrawal'
        THEN "goal_contributions"."amount_cents" < 0 AND "goal_contributions"."reason" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "goal_contributions"."amount_cents" > 0 END

goals_funding_shape_check.name: goals_funding_shape_check
goals_funding_shape_check.value:
CASE "goals"."funding_rule"
        WHEN 'percent_of_income' THEN "goals"."funding_percent_bps" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
        WHEN 'fixed_monthly' THEN "goals"."funding_amount_cents" > 0
        ELSE true END

recurring_rules_transfer_shape_check.name: recurring_rules_transfer_shape_check
recurring_rules_transfer_shape_check.value:
CASE WHEN "recurring_rules"."type"::text = 'transfer'
        THEN "recurring_rules"."counter_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recurring_rules"."category_id" IS NULL
        ELSE "recurring_rules"."counter_account_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_rules"."category_id" IS NOT NULL END

transactions_transfer_shape_check.name: transactions_transfer_shape_check
transactions_transfer_shape_check.value:
CASE WHEN "transactions"."type"::text = 'transfer'
        THEN "transactions"."counter_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL
        ELSE "transactions"."counter_account_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NOT NULL END
